purpose: Provide a concise executive-level explanation of the current HBCE public evidence surface, its value, its boundaries and the next recommended roadmap step.

current_position.summary: HBCE has a live public evidence surface composed of a MATRIX EG-001 completion page, a Public Evidence Registry and a Public Evidence Explainer.

public_evidence_surfaces.title: HBCE MATRIX EG-001 T01-T37 Complete v001
public_evidence_surfaces.role: Technical completion baseline for the MATRIX EG-001 T01-T37 evidence sequence.

public_evidence_surfaces.title: HBCE Public Evidence Registry v001
public_evidence_surfaces.role: Public index of externally readable HBCE evidence baselines.

public_evidence_surfaces.title: HBCE Public Evidence Explainer v001
public_evidence_surfaces.role: Plain-language explanation of the registry and MATRIX EG-001 baseline.

executive_value: Evidence is not only stored internally; it is publicly readable.
The first public baseline is backed by tests, Git tags, GitHub Releases and GitHub Pages deployment.
The public material distinguishes what is proven from what is not yet claimed.
The structure supports future buyer-facing, audit-facing and compliance-facing evidence packs.
what_exists_today: Git tags and GitHub Releases for the published baselines

recommended_next_steps.title: Buyer-Facing Evidence One-Pager
recommended_next_steps.purpose: Create a short external-facing buyer summary for banks, compliance, audit and public-sector stakeholders.

recommended_next_steps.title: Evidence Viewer Design

recommended_next_steps.purpose: Define how the public evidence surface connects to the IPR Onboarding App and identity/governance workflows.
